theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_c1a_whitney_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (D : Euclid n → (Euclid n →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsClosed A → ContinuousOn h A → ContinuousOn D A → (∀ Q : Set (Euclid n), IsCompact Q → Q ⊆ A → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ Q, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < δ → ‖h y - h x - D x (y - x)‖ ≤ ε * ‖y - x‖) → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ EqOn g h A ∧ ∀ a ∈ A, HasFDerivAt g (D a) a
